C0913.title: Nation's First QR Code Cash-Out Case Cracked
C0913.summary: In April 2021, Jiangdu police in Yangzhou, Jiangsu followed abnormal fund clues transferred by the local branch of the People Bank of China, formed the 4.08 task force, and carried out arrests on April 15; the case was publicly reported in October 2021. It was China first case involving illegal cash-out through merchant payment codes. The group registered merchants, applied for collection QR codes, cashed out funds for others, and charged fees across more than ten provinces. Police arrested 15 suspects and identified nearly 10 billion yuan in funds involved.
